headline: Microsoft is turning Windows search into a chat box that can carry out settings and actions.
score_reason: Pool 5, kept: a Microsoft Windows change announced 7 Oct.
importance_line: It matters to anyone who uses Windows search, and it comes less than a year after Microsoft promised to remove unneeded Copilot features from Windows 11, but the features were shown on stage and are not yet live.
summary: Engadget reports that from this fall Microsoft will turn the Windows search menu into a box where typed commands carry out thousands of actions, such as switching dark mode or sending a text from a paired phone. Pavan Davuluri, Microsoft's executive vice president of Windows and Devices, showed the change at the company's Surface event in San Francisco on Wednesday, 7 Oct 2026, and users can chat with the Copilot app from the same menu.
